text: BrennanAG has been healthy since it was built, but never actually failed over for real. This is that first real test -- and it finds something nobody expected.

The instinct is to fail back immediately. Instead, confirm what actually happened: BrennanERP fails over cleanly and stays current. The scheduling module breaks completely. Two very different outcomes from the same event.
Checking ProductionSchedulingDB directly on what's now the secondary shows it sitting there, ONLINE, completely untouched -- which a true Availability Group member could never do during a failover.

The authoritative check against sys.availability_databases_cluster confirms it: ProductionSchedulingDB was never a member of BrennanAG at all. Not a bug in the failover -- a database that was simply never inside it.
The cause is identified. Next: adding it properly, proving the fix with a second test, and closing the real gap behind it.
